text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmmm♪
Where are they? Where are they? Is everyone here yet, I wondolll~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I went for a walk to get some fresh air
and spotted Matikanetannhauser in the park.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Are you out on a stroll by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, what a coincidence~! I promised to play with my friends,
so I'm meeting them here, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah! There they are! Hey, everyone, yahooo♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser waved toward a group of young children.
All smiling, they came sprinting over to her.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text: Machi-chan, yahooo~!

text_block_list.name: Spirited Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Big Sis Machi! What're we doing today? Cops and robbers? High-ground tag?
I got faster, so I'm down for anything!
choice_data_list: (So her friends were the local kids.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then~~... let's play high-ground tag today!
Here we go! Clippity, cloppity, rock-paper-scissors-go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm "it"! All right, I'm gonna catch all of you!
Run, run, run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser was running around playing right at the children's eye level.
Her boundless energy easily rivaled theirs.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! That was so much fun!
I wonder if everyone made it back home okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The children had headed home for lunch,
leaving just Matikanetannhauser and myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, whoa! That's right, it's already lunchtime!
Ah-wah-wah, I almost forgot~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, curious? Then wanna come along with me?
That way, we can split the loot~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at the shopping district. The lively chatter of the crowd
and the sound of ringing bells drifted through the air. There must be an event going on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo~! I'm here for the lottery draw!
I've got a ton of tickets!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, O-Machi-chan. So lovely and energetic as always~!
The lottery's right over this way.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Oh, we've been waiting for ya, O-Machi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Let's see how many tickets ya got... Haha, as expected of our regular customer!
You've got a whole bunch! All right, draw as many as you like!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tables were set up in the special event area, lined with lottery boxes.
Matikanetannhauser reached her hand into one of them... and drew!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeyah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
This one is... ah, 4th prize.
Too bad. Pick any candy you like from the pile.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that's pretty far from the 1st prize 'Hemokichi-kun Costume'.
But that was only the first try. We've totally got this! Right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alrighty! On to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Take thaaaaaaat!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah, 4th prize.
Pick another candy you like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, 4th prize again. But that's okay!
Next, next, next~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How about this one!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Too bad, 4th prize!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Next! Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Too bad, this one's 4th prize too!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Down to the very last ticket... Think you can do it, O-Machi-chan?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*huff*, *puff*, *whew*~~. ...*gulp*.
Yeah. Okay, I can do this!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: You've got this! If anyone can do it, it's you, O-Machi-chan. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you worked hard to get this far.
I'm sure you'll pull something great! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you!
I'll give it everything I've got! Ready, set——!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: DOSSEEEEEEEEEI!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result of the final draw is...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —4th prize.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aww, sorry, Trainer.
If I'd pulled Hemokichi-kun, I was gonna split him with you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, can you even split a Hemokichi-kun in half...?
Oh well! Let's head back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Uncle
text_block_list.text: Hold up, wait a sec! Machi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Uncle
text_block_list.text:
You worked real hard out there, so here. A reward ice cream.
There's enough for two, so share it with your friend over there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! Yay♪
Thanks, mister! I'll come shop here again real soon~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser kept waving to everyone with the same sunny smile she had when she first arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day. We had strength training scheduled, so I headed to the gym early to check the equipment—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ei, mun!! Ei, mun!!
Ei, ei, mun!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Way ahead of our scheduled time, Matikanetannhauser was already warming up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~ Maybe I'll hit the treadmill next?
Or dumbbells? Barbells sound great too!
choice_data_list: Full of energy today, aren't you?
Full of energy today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I just had way more energy than usual leftover!
I couldn't help showing up early. —Mun!!
choice_data_list: Must've been really happy to see everyone yesterday.
Must've been really happy to see everyone yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I was! Seeing all my little kid friends and the neighborhood folks gets me so happy and pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mufufu, can't wait for my next day off!
What should I do next time~? Hm-hm-hm-hmmm♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is adored by everyone around her. Perhaps it's all the affection from those people that gives her so much energy.
